meta.frame: body: x forward, y left, z up; origin = CAD origin; SI; level body = world axes
meta.angles: roll about +x, pitch about +y (pitch > 0 nose down)

assumptions.E_G_steel: E 210 GPa, G 80.8 GPa (cad extraction), section stiffness = slice effective values in series
assumptions.mast_axis: beam nodes on x 2.51408, y 0; centroid shift at hinge / lugs (to 2.20 m) ignored
assumptions.hinge: pin rigid (penalty 1e12 N/m, 1e13 N m/rad): ux uy uz rx rz tied to the boom, ry free
assumptions.boom: rigid point mass 1275.9 kg at [1.626, -0.0457, 1.0231] m, own inertia neglected, turns about the roll pin only

boom_cylinder_k_cyl_N_m.basis: ASSUMPTION: bore ~D200 (face radius 100 mm), locked oil ~0.15 m, beta 1 GPa; Q-B3 open

backstay_k_bs_N_m.basis: JSON supports.backstay (oil only = upper bound); hoses / valve unknown (Q-B1)

assumptions.auger_coupling: rigid auger body; shoe rows x (both rails) + y springs and one vertical pinion spring, 1e12 N/m
assumptions.attachments: top sheave, winch, lower guide rigid on the nearest node; backstay eq. mass 180.9 kg at the upper pivot
assumptions.mast_damping: stiffness-proportional, zeta 0.015 at the mast-only first bending mode (CLAUDE.md structure 0.015)
assumptions.L1: reference.json L1_rigid_motor_lumped_contact (k, c), beta 1.0 GPa; crawler-on: layout D, tangential 0

dynamic_top.model: linear L1 (lifted, top) with/without the flexible mast, modal (< 300 Hz), DOP853 rtol 1e-9 piecewise between kinks. leg_stop: legs extend at v_max and stop at e_op (rear 17.245 s, front 17.696 s from motor start), exact steady ramp state 3 s before the first stop (rigid case reproduces reference.json residual pitch 0.01847 deg). crawler_release_proxy: layout-D crawler floor load (static at legs 0, total = W) applied upward to the lifted body and ramped to 0 over 0.534 s (first touch -> crawler off), legs locked; a proxy of the V4 hand-over kinks, not the V4 model. IMU C1 accelerometer tilt phi + a_y/g, theta - a_x/g; filter 2 x first order tau 0.5 s

control_band.note: loop gain estimate = crossover 0.064 Hz / f (integrating plant) x filter gain; multiply by the resonant IMU participation 1/(2 zeta) x (IMU tilt share) for a mode. 20 ms loop: Nyquist 25 Hz
